desc: Implement sliding-window median cost via coordinate compression + two Fenwick trees (count, sum); binary search for smallest index with prefix count ≥ (x+1)//2; compute cost[i] = m*cnt_lo - sum_lo + sum_hi - m*cnt_hi in O(log n) per window.
Implement O(n·k) DP with rolling arrays: dp[j] over start positions, transition dp_i[j] = min(dp_{i-1}[j], dp_{i-x}[j-1] + cost[i-x]); dp[0]=0, others inf; return dp_n[k].
Verify median-cost formula and DP on examples (expect 8 and 3); check even-x lower median correctness.
Stress test vs brute force on small random inputs; test edge cases: x = n (k=1), k*x = n (forced tiling), all elements equal (cost 0), negative numbers, large values (64-bit).
Confirm complexity O(n log n + n·k) time / O(n) space; finalize solution in starter code format.
